required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh (n,) output of x's dtype inside run().
One kernel pass that reads each element of x once, doubles it, and stores it once at the same position of the output, with correct tail handling for n elements.

forbidden_substitutions.message: The doubling must be performed by the kernel, not by a PyTorch arithmetic op or copy.
Returning the input or a host-side expression on it replaces the whole computation.
No dtype conversion is allowed anywhere in mul2.
No initialised scratch or host-side copy is part of this operator.

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level store found; the map must be done by a kernel.
No doubling arithmetic found inside the kernel.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned (n,) tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() and must not share storage with x

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: the output allocation and the single elementwise kernel. No cached state, no host-side copy or conversion of x.
